item.name: Default
item.cardSummary: The standard Evade lobby: survive nextbots with normal lives, map voting, and full progression. Use this when you want the base experience without Casual, Pro, or other rule changes.
item.access: Join the experience normally or pick Default from the Mode Browser and map-change votes.
item.objective: Survive nextbots for the full round timer using movement, utilities, and teamwork.
item.lives: Standard limited lives with the normal downed and revive rules.
item.progressionImpact: Default grind path for levels, cosmetics progress, and normal survival play.
item.specialRules: Baseline ruleset. After map changes, players can also vote Default among listed public options.

item.name: Casual
item.cardSummary: A softer public mode with infinite lives and longer rounds at reduced rewards. Built for new players learning movement and nextbots without wipe pressure.
item.access: Choose Casual from the public Mode Browser or map-change votes.
item.objective: Practice surviving nextbots with endless respawns and more time per map.
item.lives: Infinite lives. Reviving other players is not available.
item.progressionImpact: Best first mode for newcomers. Less efficient for reward farming than Default or Pro Servers.
item.specialRules: Longer rounds and infinite respawns trade off against lower rewards and no player revives.

item.name: Social Space
item.cardSummary: A no-nextbot social lobby for talking, emoting, and running maps without combat pressure. Round time is longer than standard survival modes.
item.access: Choose Social Space from the public Mode Browser.
item.objective: Hang out, explore the map, and meet players without nextbots spawning.
item.lives: Not a survival life-pool mode. No nextbots to force downs.
item.mapPool: Standard maps used as free-roam social space.
item.progressionImpact: Social and practice space, not the main route for survival rewards.
item.specialRules: No nextbots. Designed as a free-roam social mode with longer rounds.

item.name: Big Team
item.cardSummary: Large-server public Evade with a much higher player cap. Same core survival idea, but denser lobbies that need a stronger device.
item.access: Choose Big Team from the public Mode Browser.
item.objective: Play normal Evade-style survival with a much larger server population.
item.lives: Standard survival lives (not infinite like Casual).
item.duration: Follows the base mode round timing for the lobby
item.progressionImpact: For players who want crowded public chaos rather than small lobbies.
item.specialRules: Larger servers. High performance hardware is recommended.

item.name: Arena
item.cardSummary: High-pressure public survival where a single down is instant death. Experimental one-life rules make every chase matter more than Default.
item.access: Choose Arena from the public Mode Browser or map-change votes (public since the Halloween 2025 update).
item.objective: Survive nextbots with only one life and no downed safety net.
item.lives: One life only. Getting downed is instant death.
item.progressionImpact: For skilled players who want harsher life rules than Default or Casual.
item.specialRules: Experimental one-life mode. Instant death on down instead of the normal downed state.

item.name: Player Nextbots
item.cardSummary: Public mode where players can take over nextbots instead of leaving them fully AI-controlled. Fun asymmetric chase play, but the wiki currently flags it as buggy.
item.access: Choose Player Nextbots from the public Mode Browser or map-change votes.
item.objective: Either survive as a runner or hunt as a player-controlled nextbot.
item.lives: Standard runner lives. Nextbot controllers play the hunter role.
item.mapPool: Standard maps. Special rounds can still apply while nextbots are player-controlled.
item.rewardSummary: Player-controlled nextbots do not earn rewards.
item.progressionImpact: Best for messing around as nextbots or practicing against human chasers, not clean reward grinding.
item.specialRules: Players replace default AI on nextbots and can pick which nextbot to control. Some nextbot interactions differ by character. Wiki notes active bugs such as invisibility and cosmetic/equipment issues.

item.name: VC Only
item.cardSummary: Standard public survival restricted to players with voice chat enabled. Text chat is disabled so coordination has to happen by voice.
item.access: Requires Roblox voice chat enabled. Choose VC Only from the Mode Browser.
item.objective: Play normal nextbot survival while communicating only by voice.
item.progressionImpact: Same survival loop as Default, for voice-enabled lobbies only.
item.specialRules: Voice chat is required to join. Regular text chat is disabled in this mode.

item.name: Pro Servers
item.cardSummary: Level-locked harder public lobbies that only vote Hard and Expert maps and pay a small reward bonus. Aimed at higher-tier players.
item.access: Requires Level 50 or higher. Choose Pro Servers from the Mode Browser.
item.objective: Survive harder maps against nextbots with a stronger player pool.
item.mapPool: Only Hard and Expert difficulty maps appear in voting. Easy and Normal maps are excluded.
item.progressionImpact: Best public path for higher-level players who want harder maps and slightly better rewards.
item.specialRules: Level gate plus restricted hard map pool. Not the same as Casual’s easy infinite-life rules.

item.name: Interloper Mission
item.cardSummary: A campaign-style Extra mode where you clear Rebel nextbots across five AF maps. Permanent in Extra selection, but completion rewards are currently bugged.
item.access: Choose Interloper Mission from the Extra Mode Browser selection. PC is recommended.
item.objective: Kill all Rebel nextbots and progress through AF_Room, AF_Tunnel, AF_Backrooms, AF_Poolrooms, and AF_Funrooms.
item.playersTeams: Designed as a solo campaign run
item.mapPool: AF_Room, AF_Tunnel, AF_Backrooms, AF_Poolrooms, and AF_Funrooms.
item.rewardSummary: Intended reward is the Interloper character and a badge. Wiki reports completion rewards are currently broken.
item.progressionImpact: Lore and campaign content with a character unlock goal when rewards work.
item.specialRules: Campaign mission rather than a normal looped public lobby. Wiki marks the penultimate or last map as soft-locking completion and badge claims.

item.name: Legacy Evade
item.cardSummary: A temporary branch that loads Evade as it was before the Overhaul update. Useful if you prefer the old feel, but progress does not carry into the main game.
item.access: Choose Legacy Evade from the Mode Browser temporary or legacy listing.
item.objective: Play the pre-Overhaul version of Evade.
item.lives: Legacy survival rules from the pre-Overhaul build.
item.mapPool: Legacy-era maps and content for that branch.
item.rewardSummary: Purchases and progress in Legacy do not transfer to the main Overhaul game.
item.progressionImpact: Nostalgia or preference for pre-Overhaul gameplay only. Not a main progression track.
item.specialRules: Data does not save to the main game. Branch is not content-updated except for important loading or gameplay bugs.

item.name: None
item.cardSummary: VIP or community exclusive free-roam mode with no nextbots and a huge life pool. Closer to a private sandbox than competitive survival.
item.access: Available through VIP Server Panel or community servers, not normal public matchmaking.
item.objective: Run the map freely without nextbots and with effectively unlimited lives.
item.playersTeams: 15 players normally, up to 50 in community servers
item.progressionImpact: Private practice and hangout mode rather than public progression.
item.specialRules: No nextbots. Similar social free-roam idea to Social Space, but exclusive access with a very high life count.

item.name: Ghost
item.cardSummary: VIP-only mode where nextbots become phantoms that can slowly phase through walls. Raises chase pressure by reducing safe wall and corner play.
item.access: VIP Server Panel exclusive (added in the Halloween 2025 update).
item.objective: Survive nextbots that can slowly pass through walls.
item.lives: Standard survival lives unless the host changes panel settings.
item.progressionImpact: Private challenge mode for VIP lobbies.
item.specialRules: All nextbot types can slowly phase through walls as phantoms.
